Thanks Samantha — looping in Marissa (vendor master / AP intake) and Kimberly for legal name verification. A few quick items so we can complete the master record and map PO/invoice paths cleanly:

1) Legal name: please confirm the exact legal entity name as it should appear on contracts and 1099s (e.g., "Pixelforge Inc."). If you operate under a DBA, list that as well.
2) Remit / invoice instructions: preferred remit name, address, and the email where PDF invoices should be sent. If you have a different remit address than the legal address, please call that out.
3) PO contact: full name, email, and phone for the person who should receive POs (we can also accept a generic PO inbox).
4) Bank proof: we received the ACH letter — thank you. If possible, also attach a bank statement snippet or bank letter with account ending to speed verification.

We use a short intake form for new vendors; please fill this out so we capture tax classification and ACH details in the system: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1VendorIntake

If you can return the PO contact as a CSV, that works well for bulk import into our ERP. Typical turnaround is 48 business hours after we have the legal name + PO contact + W9/ACH.

Thanks — I’ll create the preliminary vendor master record once those items are confirmed.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, Procurement
Redwood Inference
